syllabusTopics: Coulomb's law: force between two point charges
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank compiled 2026-10-06 from pyqs/01-neb-2024.json and 02-neb-2022.json in this unit (stems, marks, solutions verbatim in essence).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on electric charges

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Two questions: Coulomb's law plus the 2/3 microCoulomb 0.1 m numerical (2024: 5.4 N repulsion) and the MCQ on +2/-3 microCoulomb at 0.6 m (2022: 0.15 N attractive). Signs decide push vs pull; magnitudes follow the inverse square. Induction charging (separate-then-earth) trails as theory.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: F = k q1 q2 / r2, k = 9x10^9 · superposition: vector sum · induction: separate, earth, remove earth, remove rod

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Point charges at rest in uniform medium (k absorbs it). The 0.1 m in the 2024 numerical is metres already — but microCoulomb needs 10^-6 each (meaning six powers of ten per charge, twelve total, decide the magnitude). Unlike signs attract: the MCQ tests reading, not arithmetic.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: 2024: 9x10^9 x 6x10^-12 / 0.01 = 5.4 N, repulsive (like signs). 2022 MCQ: 9x10^9 x 6x10^-12 / 0.36 = 0.15 N, attractive (unlike signs) — option (a). Multiple charges: resolve components, add vectorially.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): state F = kq1q2/r2, substitute 9x10^9 x (2x10^-6)(3x10^-6)/(0.1)2 = 5.4 N along the joining line, repulsion. NEB 2022 (1): same template at 0.6 m gives 0.15 N; opposite signs make it attractive — read the signs before the options.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: micro-to-unit conversion (10^-6 each); cm left as cm; sign blindness in attraction/repulsion verdicts. Coulomb covers statics only — moving charges add magnetism.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Torsion-balance logic: force proportional to each charge, inverse-square in distance — twist measures both. Superposition is experimental fact (pairwise forces add vectorially). Induction steps derive from conductor mobility plus earthing.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Compute magnitude first (|F|), assign push/pull from signs after. MCQ: check attraction vs repulsion options before arithmetic — half the options die on signs. Convert micro and centi units in line one.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): Coulomb's law + 2/3 uC at 0.1 m. NEB 2022 (1): +2/-3 uC at 0.6 m MCQ (0.15 N attractive). That is the complete bank.
